response.overview: The story begins when Bahar (Azhan Rani) and his wife, Tijah (Amyza Aznan) find an abandoned baby outside their house. They raise her as their adopted daughter and name her Husna. Husna is raised with love and affection and becomes Bahar's favorite. However, the situation begins to change when Tijah feels that her husband is spoiling Husna too much, fulfilling almost all of her wishes. As Husna enters her teenage years, she begins to rebel. She frequently skips school, lies and steals because she wants to escape from the life of deprivation that she has been experiencing. The situation becomes increasingly complicated when Husna runs away from home and becomes entangled in a relationship with Zafran (Hafeez Mikail), a man with a dark side.
response.title: Anugerah Tanpa Cahaya
